newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal -Dealers shift basis to August.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal -Dealers shift basis to August.

text.p: Cash soymeal markets were quiet Monday as soymeal dealers shifted basis quotes from July to August before July expires on Tuesday at 1201 CDT.
"There are a lot of buyers sitting on the sidelines," said a dealer from the Southeast. "End-users are just waiting to see what happens when July goes off."
July holds a sharp premium to August and most end-users are hoping that July will move closer to August as it nears expiration.
Most dealers that have switched basis quotes to August have taken the full spread, but few trades have been reported.
More and more processors are taking or intend to take downtime in the near future and dealers said that the expected smaller crush was supporting basis values.
"There's more downtime pending," said one Indiana dealer. "With that and the smaller crush, it's really helping the basis."
